assets.title: Versioned model adapter and child-process validation
assets.summary: Generic local research and teaching software; no student records or private exchanges.
limits: Finite synthetic and native CI checks; student-device acceptance remains unverified.
Mac Apple silicon; Windows x86-64 on Server 2022 CI.
Mac ad-hoc signed without notarization; Windows unsigned.
Mac accessibility adapter disabled; VoiceOver incomplete.

Manual Mac control inspection and an extended repeat-capture run were limited by the locked screen. Final research workflow and five final lifecycle cycles passed; ten earlier cycles passed before the final token-edit fix.
Research: 50,000 rows, 32 MiB, 64 raw/512 encoded predictors, 1,000 fits, 300-second worker budget.
Ordinary coefficient inference is available for supported full-rank unpenalized OLS/logit, not arbitrary model families.
